propositions: Within a single _run_opengrep invocation, semgrep --validate --config is called exactly once per unique detector source_path, with the cached validation result fanned out to all detectors from that source.
A shared-source validation failure quarantines every detector declared from that source as invalid_detector, preserving the per-detector detail record.
The deduplication cache is call-local only (a local dict inside _run_opengrep), introducing no persistent, module-level, or cross-scan state.
Scan execution, SARIF output normalization, and coverage record generation remain unchanged; all existing external-boundary tests pass without modification.
The implementation eliminates 11 duplicate validation calls (reducing from 22 to 10 validation subprocesses) while preserving exact evidence output equality, saving ~5.945s per two-call cycle.
